changes.description: Workspace documentation review against the current state: main 7a9e757; pull request #6 (claude/ux-card-catalog, 01dca8a) with CHG-20261021-004/005; decisions through D26. Found: a 'Current PLAY-04 D13' banner in 20 documents still saying main was untouched and the audit and hosted CI pending, although PLAY-04 was audited and merged at 9081192 (CHG-20261020-003); 'Current PLAY-03 checkpoint' banners in 12 documents; UX-01 status paragraphs opening with superseded facts (46 components, Storybook 10.6.1, card-face fonts not imported); a root README that still called the design system deferred, had no rules-data row and miscounted workspaces; ADR 0015 and 0016 status lines without their merges; a documentation index without the PLAY-03, PLAY-04 and design-system entries; CONTENT-01 and the R20 catalog requirements without the links ADR 0018 states; and an unrecorded hosted run.

Hosted run 39689564415 on pull request #6 at 01dca8a recorded from public job metadata: attempt 1, design-system 22:52:16–22:55:24Z and foundation 22:52:16–23:02:39Z, both successful. Main is 7a9e757 and does not yet contain this work.

Banners replaced with the current PLAY-04 state in 20 documents (each keeps its own link path) and the PLAY-03 banner relabelled historical in 12; UX-01 status paragraphs rewritten as the current state with a dated merge-state sentence; root README ownership, commands, workspace count, build-script and CI wording; ADR 0015 and 0016 statuses; three index rows; the CI runbook's design-system flag; CONTENT-01 precursor status and R20 links (statuses unchanged); the handoff.

Not changed, with reasons: ADR bodies keep their original decisions with dated amendments (ADR 0017 still reads 46 components and Storybook 10.6.1 in its decision text, superseded by its amendments); dated validation sections, change records and run logs are append-only; the Director's vision documents (blueprint, UX/UI standard) keep their planned versions; the diagnostic web page's synthetic Babylon cards carry no card data and belong to BOOT-01.
